stem:
This list presents the work of a civil rights advocate.

Selected Accomplishments of Dolores Huerta

• Secured disability insurance for California farmworkers
• Directed a national grape boycott to protest the dangers of pesticides for farmworkers
• ________________ ?
instruction: Which accomplishment correctly completes this list?

options.label: A
options.text: Organized armed resistance to protest police brutality against farmworkers

options.label: B
options.text: Negotiated to secure better working conditions for farmworkers

options.label: C
options.text: Filed a federal lawsuit to fight segregation against farmworkers in public facilities

options.label: D
options.text: Seized corporate farmland to protest discrimination against farmworkers

visual_elements: Selected Accomplishments of Dolores Huerta box with two accomplishments and a blank line with question mark
